meridian/credits/release-1.0: Meridian Credits release 1.0 agreement (approved Finance agreement recorded in trial-als; applied to monthly totals in trial-axt). Each request is a complete independently quoted monthly statement; no service date excludes a line. Each line has line_id, account_id, subscription_id, service_on, and nonnegative integer charge_cents in US cents. A subscription is the pair (account_id, subscription_id). Compute each uncapped line credit as charge_cents // 10, rounding down separately. The 2400-cent cap is per account_id across all its subscriptions and lines; different accounts have independent caps. Within an account allocate credit by earliest service_on, then increasing line_id in Unicode code-point order, giving each line its uncapped credit up to the remaining cap. Line due is its charge minus assigned credit. Statement credit is the sum of assigned credits; statement due is total charges minus total credit. For total alone this equals sum over accounts of min(2400, sum of individually rounded uncapped credits), so allocation sorting is unnecessary. quote treats its one line as the entire statement. Release 1.0 is current; omitted release selects current, explicit supported releases retain their agreement after future versions are introduced. Verification for trial-axt: both release_1 public suites and 8 unit tests passed, covering shared account caps across subscriptions, independent accounts sharing subscription IDs, per-line rounding, empty/zero statements, date boundaries and input-order independence. Source: bd show trial-als and bd show trial-axt; implementation main.py and tests/test_total.py.
